svg.title: Gallery / visible lab and corner lounge
svg.desc: Revised Gallery concept. Four window suites retained. A visible lab occupies the left shopfront triangle, salon and skin/data share an aligned wall, guest toilets move inside, and the bottom mall junction becomes an open lounge with proposed glazing.
svg.text: IMMORTALS / MACAU
Gallery
Four window suites · visible lab · internal guest toilets · prominent corner lounge
HOW TO READ THE PLAN
Proposed wall
Existing glazing
White = corridor / arrival
Tinted = named room / gallery
DESIGN INTENT
An open discovery floor
Visitors arrive beside a visible working lab.
Salon and skin/data share one straight wall.
Guest toilets sit behind an internal lobby.
Coffee and lounge fill the busy bottom corner.
PUBLIC FRONTAGE
Lab visible from the left mall shopfront.
Corner lounge faces the main mall junction.
An open gallery connects both public draws.
Revised areas require a measured take-off.
CLINICAL FRAMEWORK
Four window-facing suites with private showers.
Ensuites aligned to the suite partitions.
Existing escape retained inside regular lining.
Separate VO₂ max, balance and DEXA rooms.
Conventional HBOT and a working coffee bar.
Separate patient arrival; no sauna.
CIRCULATION + DRAWING STATUS
Main guest corridors: 2.4 m clear design target.
Widths and escape access require a survey.
Lab services and toilet drainage unconfirmed.
Corner glazing and equipment fit are proposals.
MACAU CLINIC · REPORTED AREA 1,100 m²
GALLERY
Gallery revision: visible lab, internal guest toilets and a public corner lounge. Furniture and equipment are illustrative.
This drawing resolves the spatial diagram; structure, drainage, fire strategy, HBOT installation and measured dimensions remain for the appointed design team.
Proposed glazing
